description_full: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings, through its subsidiaries, provides excess and surplus lines insurance and reinsurance products to small and medium-sized businesses in the United States. The company offers property and casualty insurance solutions, including general liability, commercial property, management liability, miscellaneous PL, allied healthcare, and architects and engineers insurance products to the retail, real estate, hospitality, and construction sectors. It markets and distributes its products through brokerage and small business channels. The company was formerly known as Ategrity Specialty Holdings LLC and changed its name to Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings in June 2025. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings was incorporated in 2017 and is based in New York, New York. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings operates as a subsidiary of Zimmer Financial Services Group LLC.

financial_summary: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Co is a small-cap financial services business with a $1.2B market cap on $424M of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 13% against a 9% cost of capital, a 4-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.

The business throws off $141M in free cash flow — roughly 33 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.99× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 72× is fortress-like.

Net dilution runs at 10.2% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 82% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
